metadataRaw.description:
Does your upper back feel locked up and tight and it just feels like it needs to be released with a pop or crack? 

In this video, Dr. Rowe shows you how to safely crack your upper back for INSTANT RELIEF. 

All of these low back self mobilization exercises are easy, effective and can give fast relief, even in as little as 30 SECONDS. 

Watch now and safely pop your upper back at home for quick relief!
